history.note: Process run: scoped by experiment (git rm then regen --verify and gitops/tests); the original change would have left regen and one test red.

title: P014 step 3: git rm the committed front-door-tools mirror (~5.8k files)
problem: Third step of P014, after P022 and P023: delete the generated tree for the retired k3s origin.
evidence: git ls-files gitops/prod/front-door-tools: 5,839 files on origin/main 2029d18f86
change: Not a bare git rm. Tried 2026-10-16: deleting gitops/prod/front-door-tools makes regen --verify report 5,918 missing artifacts (front-door-tools.mjs --write is still one of its two generators) and fails gitops/tests/test_manifests.py::test_mirrored_tool_count_matches_what_the_docs_claim; kustomization.yaml also lists front-door-tools/ as a resource. So in one PR: (1) drop the front-door-tools.mjs step from regen.mjs --verify/write, (2) remove the front-door-tools/ resource and mirror-count assertions, (3) git rm the tree; keep front-door.mjs and the --headroom guard if still meaningful. The regen checklist lines stay (P023 dropped).
